confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors agree reasonably across several Kathmandu aggregator sites, but most are undated and tourist-area prices vary widely. Accommodation anchors come from booking-aggregator snapshots, not verified July 2026 rates, and the 1-star figure is partly inferred. Wine is estimated from the local beer relationship because no glass-price source was found. The cocktail anchor rests on one crowd-sourced figure and one upscale bar. The FX observation could not be verified: I did not open any rba.gov.au page. A third-party site reported 0.6947 USD per AUD for 16 October 2026, and Trading Economics reported 0.6923 for the same day, so the fx fields are null until the RBA F11.1 table is checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Anchors are based on Kathmandu-specific aggregator price snapshots (WhereAndWhen, CityCost, Mylifeelsewhere, Expatistan, Hostelz, Kayak, Expedia, Kathmandu Post), mostly undated, with July treated as low season. Food, beer and coffee anchors are triangulated across sources; accommodation, wine and cocktail anchors are thinner.
